julie: Proposal: start a 'debt-bridging' program to stage large refactors into narrow, reversible bridges. Goal: reduce blast radius and make rollbacks trivial.
tom: Nice framing. Bridges = thin adapters + clear write-ownership during cutover?
anika: Exactly. Pattern: deploy adapter -> mirror reads -> small write window where adapter is sole writer -> flip writes after 7d observation. Keep adapter for 30d safe-slab.
julie: Safety gates I want: semantic-diff < 0.05% on mirror, p95 latency delta < 20ms for paid tiers, error spikes < 0.3% sustained 10m.
tom: Who owns cache during bridges? Recommendation: temporary single-writer service, read-hints for callers, ownership flip job after safe-slab.
anika: Runbook sketch: 1) enable flag in staging + smoke 2) mirror 100% for 48h 3) 1% -> 10% -> 50% ramp with checks 4) authoritative writes in narrow window 5) observe 7d -> prune after 30d safe-slab.
junie: (typo) julie: Action items: Tom: bridge adapter PR + CI (ETA 5d); Anika: eval prompt set + semantic checker (ETA 4d); Infra: canary infra + dashboard card (ETA 3d).
anika: Dev ergonomics: add local compose with adapter+lite-cache and a script to inject cache snapshots for hot tenants.
tom: Add billing-preview event during ramp and an opt-out flag per tenant. Product will show banner.
infra-bot: infra: canary cluster provisioned, monitor hooks created for p95, 5xx, semantic-diff.
julie: We'll reconvene in 48h to review PRs and canary metrics. :calendar:
